a.speaker: tommy
a.text: Cassie? It's me. Don't hang up. I know what this is. I'm calling from the house.

b.speaker: tommy
b.text: Everybody came. The guards from the motel, Arlo's boys, the stagehands. They've got stars on their faces now. Your stars.

d.speaker: tommy
d.text: So are they. Nobody here minds. Come up to the ballroom. There's a gun on every table. Mom would hate it.

e.speaker: dead
e.text: Checkout was midnight... checkout was midnight...
